Thanks for reporting this. An automated hermes-sweeper review found that current `main` includes the Desktop clarify rendering fix.

- Commit `9e7fe2dd014e7c12859dec12f70a1d20281c125b` (`fix(desktop): keep answered clarify Q&A visible in the transcript`) prevents answered clarify prompts from collapsing into a generic row that hides the selected option.
- `apps/desktop/src/components/assistant-ui/clarify-tool.tsx:205-207` receives the choices, and `:382-397` renders each as a visible button.
- `apps/desktop/src/components/assistant-ui/clarify-tool.test.tsx:80-100` covers retaining the question and selected answer in the transcript.

Closing as implemented on main.
